children: Aeluma, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $4.46M and a net loss of $9.16M, with diluted EPS of $(0.52), compared with revenue of $4.67M, a net loss of $3.02M and diluted EPS of $(0.23) in fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $4.46M for FY 2026, down from $4.67M in FY 2025 (4%).
Net income: Net loss $9.16M for FY 2026, compared with net loss $3.02M in FY 2025 (loss widened).
Diluted EPS was $(0.52) for FY 2026, compared with $(0.23) for FY 2025 (more negative YoY).
Revenue mix remained heavily weighted to government contracts, totaling approximately $4.3M of FY 2026 revenue.
Added six new government contracts during the year, including awards from NASA, SUNY and the Office of the Secretary of Defense.
Operating spend increased roughly 115% to support material purchases, hiring, and scaling manufacturing and R&D operations.
Raised about $60M through public offerings and ATM proceeds to fund product development and market readiness.
Signed a letter of intent for up to $30M in CHIPS Act funding, contingent on approvals, milestone delivery and equity issuance.
